not_installed.name: pi-llama-cpp
not_installed.reason: Reviewed and adopted 2026-08-06 for the EXT-13 local lane, then made moot: owner decision, 2026-08-15, the provider set is exactly github-copilot, an OpenAI-compatible gateway and databricks, and the whole local-model-server lane is deleted. The package served nothing else - it never registered the provider id `local` (its own prefix is `llama-server`, its default port :8080) and nothing in extensions/ ever imported it. Uninstalled 2026-08-15 rather than left pinned-but-dead. A model server on loopback is still reachable through config/providers/openai-compatible.json, which needs no package at all. Re-adopting it needs a fresh review AND a provider to adopt it for.

not_installed.name: pi-hashline-edit-pro
not_installed.reason: Uninstalled 2026-08-29, dead-dependency sweep. Adopted 2026-08-06 as the EXT-19t edit trial; the trial never ran - it was never added to config/settings.default.json's packages[], which is the only load list, and nothing under extensions/ ever imported it, so PI never loaded it. docs/limitations.md records that it cannot load under the Bun runtime `pi` ships as (`No such built-in module: node:sqlite`), so wiring it was never an option either. It also carries its own typebox as a regular dependency, which would put two typebox realms in one process. Re-adopting it needs a fresh review AND an actual trial to adopt it for.

not_installed.name: pi-opa-net
not_installed.reason: Uninstalled 2026-08-29, dead-dependency sweep. Adopted-conditional 2026-08-06 for an OPA policy engine that needs an external `opa` binary this harness does not ship and does not require; never in config/settings.default.json's packages[], never imported. The deny path is EXT-15's own hook layer, which is custom and fails closed - see docs/DENYLIST.md's `pi-yaml-hooks` row for why that is deliberate. docs/limitations.md records it aborting startup outright when wired (`undefined is not an object (evaluating '_index.default')`), a packaging bug on its side, so its fail-mode polarity was never exercised here.

not_installed.name: pi-smart-compact
not_installed.reason: Uninstalled 2026-08-29, dead-dependency sweep. docs/PACKAGES.md already carried it as adopted-optional and not wired: never in config/settings.default.json's packages[], never imported. EXT-11 did not adopt it on the merits - it competes on summary quality, which is not the requirement, and implements no compaction loop guard, which is. docs/limitations.md records that it cannot load under the Bun runtime `pi` ships as (`NameTooLong while resolving package 'data:text/javascript;base64,...'`). No `smartCompact` key was ever shipped in config/settings.default.json, so nothing was left behind by removing it.

not_installed.name: pi-web-search
not_installed.reason: Uninstalled 2026-08-29, dead-dependency sweep, on the licence ground docs/DENYLIST.md names first: it declares MIT and ships no licence text anywhere, so a tree that redistributes it redistributes an unlicensed copy. It was carried here with `licenseTextShipped: false` - the ledger acknowledgement PC-17 accepts - which is defensible for a package that earns its place and indefensible for one that never loaded. It never did: not in config/settings.default.json's packages[], never imported, and docs/limitations.md records that wiring it is impossible anyway because its `web_search` tool name collides with the adopted pi-web-access. Nothing is lost: pi-web-access serves `web_search`/`web_fetch` and extensions/web/answer.ts serves `web_answer` off the same backend.

not_installed.name: @99percentpeople/pi-background-tasks
not_installed.reason: Uninstalled 2026-08-29, dead-dependency sweep. Adopted-hardened 2026-08-06 as the bash face of background work; never wired - not in config/settings.default.json's packages[], and the only references under extensions/jobs were prose. EXT-24 shipped its own cross-session job directory instead, precisely because this package (like pi-subagents' async runs) is session-scoped and its work dies with the process that started it. docs/limitations.md also records it failing to load under Bun (`Cannot find module '@xterm/headless'`).

not_installed.name: @nklisch/pi-plugins
not_installed.reason: Uninstalled 2026-08-29, dead-dependency sweep. It could never have loaded here: `engines.node` is >= 24 against this repository's floor of 22.19.0, and docs/limitations.md records the Bun failure too (`No such built-in module: node:sqlite`). It was never in config/settings.default.json's packages[] and docs/PACKAGES.md already recorded it as not this repository's install path. It also dragged in two unreviewed forks that appear in no ledger here (@nklisch/pi-subagents 18.1.0-nklisch.0, @nklisch/pi-mcp-adapter 2.20.1-nklisch.0).

sha256_method: npm pack --ignore-scripts, then shasum -a 256 on the resulting tarball. The npm_dist_shasum_sha1 field is npm's own SHA-1 and is recorded only as a cross-check.
